description: This file defines the 'Proxifier' utility class which provides methods to create dynamic proxy instances for objects using reflection. It allows wrapping objects with specified wrappers and generating proxies that implement the same interfaces as the original objects.

classes.name: Proxifier
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to create proxy instances and wrappers for objects.

methods.name: proxy
methods.description: Creates a proxy for the given object 't' using the specified wrapper class 'cls'.

methods.name: proxy
methods.description: Creates a proxy for the given object 't' with the provided 'Wrapper' instance.

methods.name: instantiate
methods.description: Instantiates a Wrapper object wrapping the object 't' by invoking its constructor with 't' as parameter.
